title: Join the lab
text:
Undergraduates
We take [number] students each term for [project type]. Email with your CV, a transcript, and a note on your availability.

Writing to us
Send one email to you@university.edu with the subject line Lab enquiry — [your name]. Tell us what you want to work on rather than what you have done; the CV covers the second part. We reply to everyone, usually within a week.

We particularly encourage applications from people underrepresented in [field]. If a formal requirement is a barrier for you, say so — it is often negotiable.

title: Research
text:
Overview
A short paragraph framing the whole programme: the gap in the field, why it matters now, and the through-line connecting the themes below. Two or three sentences is plenty — the detail belongs in the sections.
